zh: ML-DSA：FIPS 204 的模块格数字签名算法。
Fiat-Shamir with Aborts：允许签名过程中放弃重试的 Fiat-Shamir 变体。
拒绝采样：系数超出允许范围时丢弃并重试的步骤。
承诺值 y：每轮签名使用、必须保持唯一且不可预测的随机向量。
t0：公钥多项式 t 每个系数低位部分的编码。
确定性变体：不引入额外随机数的签名方式。
en: ML-DSA: the module-lattice digital signature algorithm of FIPS 204.
Fiat-Shamir with Aborts: a Fiat-Shamir variant that allows retrying during signing.
Rejection sampling: discarding and retrying when coefficients fall outside a range.
Commitment value y: the per-signing random vector that must be unique and unpredictable.
t0: the encoding of the low bits of each coefficient of the public polynomial t.
Deterministic variant: signing that introduces no extra randomness.
